payload.reason: The sensitivity study was conducted to explore the extreme scenario of zero remineralization of biomass, which allows for the assessment of the long-term impacts on nutrient availability and carbon storage in the ocean.

claims.text: The sensitivity study was designed to simulate an extreme case where all macroalgal biomass is permanently buried upon reaching the seafloor, with no remineralization occurring.
This approach helps estimate the range of possible fates of remineralized organic matter and its effects on marine ecosystems.
The study also represents a different macroalgae farming approach, focusing on the permanent removal of biomass from the ocean.
